description:
Smith-Morra Gambit: kicking the knight with a pawn looks natural, but the knight jumps in with check and forks king and rook. The queen has to take, and she is lost. Better: push the center pawn and hit the bishop first. Would you have seen it? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
